description: This source file implements the TpmGatekeeper class, which manages TPM-based security operations such as key retrieval, signature computation, and failure record management within the Android Open Source Project's secure environment.

classes.name: TpmGatekeeper
classes.description: A class that interfaces with TPM hardware to perform cryptographic operations and manage failure records for secure authentication.

methods.name: GetAuthTokenKey
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token key used for TPM gatekeeper operations.

methods.name: GetPasswordKey
methods.description: Retrieves the password key used for TPM gatekeeper operations.

methods.name: ComputePasswordSignature
methods.description: Computes a cryptographic signature over the password and salt.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Generates a random byte sequence using TPM's random source.

methods.name: ComputeSignature
methods.description: Computes an HMAC-based signature over a message with a given key.

methods.name: GetMillisecondsSinceBoot
methods.description: Returns the milliseconds elapsed since system boot.

methods.name: GetFailureRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the failure record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: ClearFailureRecord
methods.description: Clears the failure record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: WriteFailureRecord
methods.description: Writes a failure record for a specific user ID.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Indicates whether the security is hardware-backed.
